## Linked Issue

Closes #

## Exact behavioral claim

What is now true, and what failure does this prevent?

## Scope

What changed? What nearby behavior deliberately did not change?

## Rules conformance

If this touches the rules engine: which section of the ORC Content Document does
it implement, and which printed table did you verify against?

## Tests and evidence

Exact commands and results. Do not write "tests pass" without naming the command.

## Decisions and tradeoffs

Any material judgment made during implementation.

## Known limitations

State what remains unresolved. Write "None" if there are none.

## Agent provenance

Which agent or model implemented and reviewed this change?

## Checklist

- [ ] The linked Issue and acceptance criteria were read.
- [ ] The diff contains one concern.
- [ ] Focused verification passed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation changed with the behavior.
- [ ] No unrelated cleanup is included.
- [ ] No out-of-scope content was implemented (see `orc-scope-filter.md`).
